subject.title: refactor: remove stale internal deprecated compatibility

question: Does the current-head compatibility audit prove that every deleted alias or field is outside all shipped and external package surfaces?
rationale: Protected labels require explicit handling, and removal of deprecated exported shapes needs maintainer confirmation when an independent direct history and package-reachability audit is incomplete.

options.title: Approve after contract audit
options.body: Confirm the removed symbols are internal-only, verify the restored plugin SDK fields, and merge the current head if the exact-head gates remain green.

options.title: Restore uncertain aliases
options.body: Retain any deprecated member whose package reachability or shipped status cannot be disproven, then schedule removal through the coordinated compatibility process.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Keep the PR open until another reviewer can complete the source, package-surface, and release-history audit.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract audit
recommendation.body: Confirm the removed symbols are internal-only, verify the restored plugin SDK fields, and merge the current head if the exact-head gates remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies this person as the cleanup sponsor and coordinator with the strongest knowledge of the classification and restored contracts.
